description.value: Sungiven Foods is a Metro Vancouver Asian supermarket chain emphasizing natural, less-processed products with over 500 private-label items certified to international quality standards. The Burnaby location on Marine Way stocks a wide range of produce, meat, seafood, dairy, and packaged goods alongside a prepared-foods counter called Sungiven Kitchen. The chain operates across Vancouver, Richmond, Burnaby, Surrey, White Rock, Coquitlam, and Langley, making it a recognizable resupply option for cyclists touring the Lower Mainland.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Sungiven Foods is an active Asian-focused supermarket chain with locations across Metro Vancouver including Burnaby. The website's product categories (produce, dairy, eggs, meat, seafood, packaged goods, beverages, snacks) confirm broad grocery coverage, and the 'Sungiven Kitchen' section with multiple named prepared dishes under 'Ready to Eat' supports a hot/prepared food offering. No bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website or OSM tags, so those remain null.
